def strip_and_count(line):
    depth = 0
    min_depth = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(line):
        ch = line[i]
        # Single-line comment
        if ch == '/' and i+1 < len(line) and line[i+1] == '/':
            break
        # Multi-line comment  
        if ch == '/' and i+1 < len(line) and line[i+1] == '*':
            end = line.find('*/', i+2)
            i = (end + 2) if end >= 0 else len(line)
            continue
        # Double-quoted string
        if ch == '"':
            i += 1
            while i < len(line):
                if line[i] == '\\\\': 
                    i += 2; continue
                if line[i] == '"': i+=1; break
                i += 1
            continue
        # Single-quoted string
        if ch == \"'\":
            i += 1
            while i < len(line):
                if line[i] == '\\\\': 
                    i += 2; continue
                if line[i] == \"'\": i+=1; break
                i += 1
            continue
        # Template literal
        if ch == '\`':

# Tokenizer that handles strings and template literals properly  
def strip_code(line):
    result = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(line):
        ch = line[i]
        # Single-line comment
        if ch == '/' and i+1 < len(line) and line[i+1] == '/':
            break
        # Multi-line comment
        if ch == '/' and i+1 < len(line) and line[i+1] == '*':
            end = line.find('*/', i+2)
            i = end + 1 if end >= 0 else len(line) - 1
            continue
        # Double-quoted string
        if ch == '"':
            result.append("'")  # placeholder
            i += 1
            while i < len(line):
                if line[i] == '\\': i += 2; continue
                if line[i] == '"': i++; break
                i += 1
            continue
        # Single-quoted string  
        if ch == "'":
            result.append('"')  # placeholder
            i += 1
            while i < len(line):
                if line[i] == '\\': i += 2; continue
                if line[i] == "'": i++; break
                i += 1
            continue
        # Template literal - handle ${} as real braces
        if ch == '`':
            i += 1
            while i < len(line) and line[i] != '`':
                if line[i] == '\\': result.append(' '); i += 2; continue
                if line[i] == '$' and i+1 < len(line) and line[i+1] == '{':
                    # ${ starts embedded expression - count the { as real brace
                    result.append('{')
                    i += 2  # skip $ and {
                    # Now find matching } for template expr
                    depth = 1
                    while i < len(line) and depth > 0:
                        if line[i] == '{':

                        elif line[i] == '}':

                            if depth > 0: result.append('}')
                        else:

                        i += 1
                    continue
                result.append(line[i])
                i += 1
            if i < len(line): i += 1  # skip closing `
            continue
        result.append(ch)
        i += 1
    return ''.join(result)
